enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in own bedroom with the air conditioner running on a moderate setting to cope with the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Place the head on the pillow. Close eyes. Turn onto the side. Adjust the pillow with the hand. Remain lying on the bed. Turn onto the back. Rest the arms beside the body. Breathe slowly. Turn onto the other side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Remain lying on the bed. Shift the legs. Turn the head on the pillow. Continue sleeping. Keep the body still on the mattress. Remain in bed until 06:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, using the toilet, washing face and taking a cool shower to start the hot day
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom door. Push the bathroom door open. Press the bathroom light switch on. Sit on the toilet. Stand up from the toilet. Press the flush button. Walk to the sink. Turn on the tap. Cup water in the hands. Rinse the face. Turn off the tap. Pick up the towel from the rail. Wipe the face. Hang the towel on the rail. Step into the shower area. Turn on the shower tap. Turn the tap to cool water. Wet the body under the water. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the arms, torso and legs. Put the soap back on the shelf. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Pick up the towel. Dry the body. Hang the towel on the rail. Press the bathroom light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating a light breakfast of toast with the toaster and a cup of tea from the kettle, drinking extra water ahead of the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the kitchen light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the bread. Take out the milk. Close the refrigerator door. Place the bread and milk on the counter. Open the cupboard door. Take out a cup. Close the cupboard door. Place the cup on the counter. Take the toaster. Plug the toaster into the socket. Put one slice of bread into the toaster slot. Press the toaster lever down. Take the kettle to the sink. Turn on the tap. Fill the kettle with water. Turn off the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Take a plate from the cupboard. Place the plate on the counter. Take the toast out of the toaster when it pops up. Place the toast on the plate. Put the second slice of bread into the toaster. Press the lever down. Open the refrigerator. Take out the butter. Close the refrigerator door. Spread the butter on the toast with a knife. Pour the hot water into the cup. Add milk to the cup. Sit at the table. Pick up the toast. Eat the toast. Pick up the cup. Drink the tea. Turn on the tap. Fill a glass with water. Drink the water. Refill the glass. Drink the water. Stand up. Carry the plate and cup to the sink. Rinse the plate and cup. Place them on the drying rack. Press the kitchen light switch off. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in light work clothes, packing a water bottle, sunscreen and lunch into a bag, and turning off the bedroom light and air conditioner before leaving
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a light shirt. Take out trousers. Close the wardrobe door. Take off the night clothes. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Put on socks. Open the drawer. Take out a water bottle. Close the drawer. Place the water bottle into the bag. Pick up the sunscreen tube from the shelf. Place the sunscreen into the bag. Take the lunch box from the desk. Place the lunch box into the bag. Zip the bag closed. Press the bedroom light switch off. Pick up the air conditioner remote. Press the power button to turn the air conditioner off. Place the remote on the bedside table. Pick up the bag. Walk to the bedroom door. Pull the door open. Walk out. Pull the bedroom door closed.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital on public transport in the morning heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the building. Walk along the pavement to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Press the phone power button. Check the bus time on the screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus when it arrives. Tap the card on the card reader. Walk down the aisle. Grip the overhead handrail. Stand beside the door. Step off the bus at the hospital stop. Walk along the pavement to the hospital entrance. Push the entrance door open. Walk to the staff locker room. Open the locker door. Take the work uniform from the locker. Take off the outer clothes. Put on the work uniform. Hang the bag inside the locker. Close the locker door. Walk towards the ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a hospital physiotherapist: assessing inpatients, running rehabilitation exercises and supervising mobility sessions on the ward
enriched_activities.desc: Walk onto the ward. Pick up the patient clipboard from the desk. Read the patient notes on the clipboard. Walk to the first bed. Greet the patient. Ask the patient about the pain level. Help the patient sit up on the bed edge. Hold the patient's arm. Guide the patient to stand. Walk beside the patient along the corridor. Count the steps aloud. Guide the patient back to the bed. Guide the patient to sit on the chair. Demonstrate the arm raise exercise. Raise the arm. Lower the arm. Demonstrate the knee bend exercise. Bend the knee. Extend the knee. Ask the patient to repeat the movement. Correct the patient's posture with the hand. Record the mobility score on the chart with a pen. Move to the next bed. Greet the next patient. Pick up the walker. Place the walker in front of the patient. Supervise the patient walking with the walker. Return the walker to the corner. Write the treatment note on the chart. Walk back to the nurses' station. Place the clipboard on the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital staff room, eating a packed lunch and rehydrating in the air-conditioned area
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the staff room. Push the staff room door open. Walk to the table. Place the bag on the chair. Open the bag zip. Take out the lunch box. Open the lunch box lid. Take out the fork. Sit on the chair. Eat the food with the fork. Pick up the water bottle. Open the bottle cap. Drink the water. Close the bottle cap. Stand up. Walk to the water dispenser. Refill the bottle. Walk back to the table. Sit on the chair. Open the bottle cap. Drink the water. Close the bottle cap. Close the lunch box lid. Place the lunch box back into the bag. Zip the bag closed. Wipe the table with a tissue. Throw the tissue into the bin. Stand up. Pick up the bag. Push the staff room door open. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical work: outpatient physiotherapy appointments, documenting treatment notes and instructing patients on home exercise programmes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the outpatient treatment room. Push the door open. Greet the patient. Sit on the chair. Press the computer keyboard. Open the appointment list on the screen. Move the mouse. Click the patient file. Stand up. Guide the patient through the shoulder exercise. Hold the patient's arm. Rotate the arm. Release the arm. Guide the patient to lie on the treatment bed. Press the hand on the patient's knee. Guide the knee bend. Guide the patient to sit up. Say the exercise sets to the patient. Take the home exercise sheet from the drawer. Circle the exercise sets with a pen. Hand the sheet to the patient. Answer the patient's questions. Open the treatment note on the computer. Type the treatment notes on the keyboard. Save the file. Close the program. Stand up. Walk the patient to the door. Push the door open. Walk back to the desk. Pick up the next patient file.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from the hospital during the peak heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the locker room. Open the locker door. Take off the work uniform. Put on the outer clothes. Take the bag out of the locker. Close the locker door. Walk out of the hospital building. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Take the phone out of the pocket. Press the phone power button. Check the bus time on the screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the card on the card reader. Walk down the aisle. Grip the overhead handrail. Stand beside the door. Step off the bus at the home stop. Walk along the pavement to the building. Climb the stairs. Take the key from the pocket. Insert the key into the lock. Turn the key. Push the front door open. Walk inside. Close the door behind.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating dinner using the refrigerator, induction cooker and range hood, keeping the air conditioner off during the peak grid request period
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Press the kitchen light switch on. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables. Take out the meat. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Open the drawer. Take out a knife and cutting board. Place the cutting board on the counter. Wash the vegetables under the tap. Turn off the tap. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board with the knife. Cut the meat into pieces. Press the range hood switch on. Press the induction cooker power button on. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Place the meat into the pan. Stir the meat with the spatula. Add the vegetables into the pan. Add salt. Stir the food. Press the induction cooker power button off. Press the range hood switch off. Scoop the food onto a plate. Carry the plate to the table. Sit on the chair. Eat the dinner with chopsticks. Drink water from the glass. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Rinse the plate. Place the plate on the drying rack. Press the kitchen light switch off. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV with the air conditioner switched off as requested, using the dehumidifier briefly to keep the room comfortable
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Press the living room light switch on. Sit on the sofa. Pick up the TV remote from the table. Press the TV power button. Point the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Change the channel. Press the volume button. Place the remote on the sofa arm. Watch the TV. Stand up. Walk to the dehumidifier. Press the dehumidifier power button on. Walk back to the sofa. Sit on the sofa. Watch the TV. Stand up. Walk to the dehumidifier. Press the dehumidifier power button off. Walk back to the sofa. Sit on the sofa. Pick up the remote. Press the TV power button off. Place the remote on the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower, washing up and starting a load of laundry in the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Push the bathroom door open. Press the bathroom light switch on. Turn on the shower tap. Turn the tap to cool water. Step under the water. Wet the body. Pick up the soap. Rub the soap on the arms, torso and legs. Put the soap back on the shelf. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Pick up the towel from the rail. Dry the body. Hang the towel on the rail. Open the washing machine lid. Pick up the laundry from the basket. Place the clothes into the washing machine drum. Open the detergent box. Pour detergent into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Close the washing machine lid. Press the washing machine start button. Press the bathroom light switch off. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing patient treatment plans and updating professional development notes on the computer under the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the study. Press the study light switch on. Pull the chair out. Sit on the chair. Press the computer power button. Place the hands on the keyboard. Type the password. Move the mouse. Click the patient file on the screen. Read the treatment plan on the monitor. Scroll the page with the mouse wheel. Open the professional development page. Read the article on the monitor. Type a summary on the keyboard. Press the desk lamp switch on. Adjust the lamp head. Continue typing. Press the keyboard keys. Save the file with the keyboard shortcut. Close the program. Move the mouse. Click the shutdown option. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Press the desk lamp switch off.

enriched_activities.activity: Hanging the washed clothes to dry and tidying the living area before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Pick up the drying rack. Unfold the drying rack. Walk to the bathroom. Open the washing machine lid. Take out a shirt. Shake the shirt. Walk to the living room. Hang the shirt on the drying rack. Walk to the bathroom. Take out the trousers. Shake the trousers. Walk to the living room. Hang the trousers on the drying rack. Take out the towel. Hang the towel on the drying rack. Pick up the cushion from the floor. Place the cushion on the sofa. Pick up the cup from the table. Carry the cup to the kitchen. Place the cup on the counter. Walk back to the living room. Fold the blanket. Place the blanket on the sofa arm. Straighten the chairs. Push the chairs under the table. Press the living room light switch off. Walk out of the living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in own bedroom, checking the phone, setting an air conditioner timer and dimming the light
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Press the bedroom light switch on. Sit on the bed. Pick up the phone from the bedside table. Press the phone power button. Scroll the screen with the finger. Press the message icon. Read the messages. Press the phone power button off. Place the phone on the bedside table. Pick up the air conditioner remote. Press the power button to turn the air conditioner on. Press the timer button. Set the timer. Place the remote on the bedside table. Stand up. Press the light dimmer switch. Dim the light. Pull the blanket back. Sit on the bed. Lie down on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in own bedroom with the air conditioner set to a comfortable overnight temperature
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Place the head on the pillow. Close eyes. Turn onto the side. Adjust the pillow with the hand. Pick up the air conditioner remote from the bedside table. Press the temperature button. Place the remote on the bedside table. Remain lying on the bed. Turn onto the back. Rest the arms beside the body. Breathe slowly. Turn onto the other side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Shift the legs. Remain lying on the bed. Keep the body still on the mattress. Continue sleeping through the night.
